outcome.technical: WHAT CHANGED. _evidence_io.py: read_rows (line 1994) returns the union of the ledger rows and every lastRun record the plan holds, one entry per runId, the ledger row winning where both hold a run and the record's launch merged onto it (with_records, 3050); new keys rowSources (ROW_FROM_LEDGER/ROW_FROM_RECORD), records, unreadablePlanFiles and ledgerAbsent (a sentence naming the missing evidence directory, None when it exists); files/unreadable/unreadableFiles stay the ledger's; for a record entry rowFiles is the repo-relative plan file holding it. New: record_row (2940, the row shape of a record), records_of_bodies (2971; a gradedBy copy is read under its carrier; a repeat's source is emitted BEFORE the repeat because oldest_first gives a tie to the entry read later - found by lt3, where a repeat and its source shared a second), plan_bodies (3014), plan_file_of, run_by_launch (3075). RECORD_ROW_KEYS/RECORD_STEP_KEYS/RECORD_STATE_KEYS widened to the fields readers ask (baseRed, muted, groupWith, scope digests, step reuse marks, failing basis...). WRITER-SIDE, REPORTED: run_record (2777) now writes REPEATED_RUN_KEY ('repeatedRun') - a reused or part-reused record carries its source run's record whole, so records-only readers follow reusedFrom to the measurer; a repeat's record therefore holds up to two runs' steps. write_record, write_pointer and reconcile are untouched and no lock is pinned. _verdict_binding.py: plan_records/subject_runs; binding, phase_binding and member_red take records (default: the plan at manifest_path) and read the union; the 'repeats run X, which is not in the ledger' sentence now says 'nor in any record the plan holds'. close-phase.py: tip_bodies + branch_records read the plan index and its shards at refs/heads/<branch> (cat-file) plus the worktree holding the branch, passed to phase_binding and member_red. drive-phase.py: launch_token/with_launch/LAUNCH_FLAG; launch_gate and launch_phase_gate put --launch <token> on the argv and mark {at, argv, launch} (no known list); new_gate_row finds the subject's run carrying the token via run_by_launch over read_rows; a mark with no token (an older drive's) is not read back: a task gate is launched again with a warning, a phase-gate launch is forgotten and its gate chosen again. audit-task.py: _ledger_run's refusal names both places (the evidence dir, 'which does not exist' when ledgerAbsent, and the plan file) and counts unreadablePlanFiles as a lost read; serves --failing-from, couple --basis-run and --caught. run-test-gate.py: _run_record_of fetches the source run for PART_REUSED as well as REUSED, through read_rows. Docs: CHANGELOG Unreleased/Changed entry; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE paragraphs under _evidence_io (one reader, two places), drive-phase (launch token), close-phase (branch_records, cr33/cr34), _verdict_binding (subject_runs), audit-task couple (_ledger_run). DELETED AS UNREACHABLE/OBSOLETE: drive-phase subject_run_ids and task_run_ids (their only callers were the known-list launch marks and new_gate_row), the known-list comparison in new_gate_row, and the ledger-unreadable _stopped branches at the top of launch_gate/launch_phase_gate (a launch no longer reads the ledger). Nothing else became unreachable: the frozen ledger is still read, so older/newer-row branches (newer_for_identity, the ledger-unreadable paths) still have inputs; reconcile's record branch now overlaps read_rows' union but reconcile is writer-side and was left alone.
